# AI

7 tools for AI perception senses and stimuli sources, sight radius, AI controller Blueprints and team attitudes.

Back to the [index](README.md).

## `add_ai_stimuli_source`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Adds a UAIPerceptionStimuliSourceComponent to an actor and registers it as a source for the supplied AISense (default Sight). Idempotent: re-run returns the existing component.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Display label or internal name of the target editor-world actor (required) |
| `sense` | string | no | "Sight" \| "Hearing" \| "Damage" (default "Sight") |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, component_name: string, sense: string, registered: bool, already_existed: bool }`

## `create_ai_controller_blueprint`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Create a Blueprint asset parented to AAIController, compile and save it.  Idempotent: if the asset already exists it is loaded and returned.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Asset name (e.g. BP_EnemyAIController) |
| `package_path` | string | no | Target /Game package path (optional, default "/Game/Blueprints") |

**Returns:** `{ name: string, asset_path: string, parent_class: string, generated_class: string, is_ai_controller: bool, already_existed: bool, created: bool }`

## `get_actor_team`

*Read-only.*

Reads the native FGenericTeamId assigned to an actor (or its Controller, for a Pawn possessed by an AAIController). Returns the engine-reserved NoTeam id (255) if neither the actor nor its Controller implements IGenericTeamAgentInterface.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Display label or internal name (required) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, team_id, resolved_on: "actor"|"controller"|"none", is_no_team }`

## `get_ai_perceived_actors`

*Read-only.*

List the actors that the AIPerceptionComponent of an AI-possessed pawn, or of an AIController, currently perceives by any sense, without changing anything. The actor is looked up in the editor world, not PIE, so an unpossessed pawn is an error. Returns count and perceived [{actor_name}]; no last-sensed time is included.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name or editor label of the pawn or AIController in the editor world; the first match is used. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, perceived: [{actor_name}], count }`

## `set_actor_team`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the native team id (FGenericTeamId) of an actor in the editor world through IGenericTeamAgentInterface, falling back to its Controller when the actor does not implement it (an ACharacter possessed by an AAIController, the only implementer in vanilla UE 5.8), then refresh that agent's AI Perception listeners so Sight, Hearing and Touch affiliation filtering sees the new team at once. The previous team is overwritten in memory only: no undo step, nothing dirtied or saved, and on an AAIController it is gone when the level reloads. The same id again gives the same result. Read it with get_actor_team; set_native_team_attitude decides whether two teams are friendly, neutral or hostile. An unknown actor, a team_id outside 0-254, or no team interface on the actor or its controller is an error and nothing changes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name or label of the actor in the editor world (a pawn, or the AIController itself), e.g. 'BP_Guard_C_0'. |
| `team_id` | number | yes | Team number, an integer in [0, 254], e.g. 1; 255 is the engine-reserved NoTeam id and is refused. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, team_id, applied, resolved_on: "actor"|"controller", perception_listeners_refreshed }`

## `set_ai_sight_radius`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set SightRadius and LoseSightRadius (default sight_radius times 1.5) on the sight config of the AIPerceptionComponent of an AI-possessed pawn or an AIController. The actor is looked up in the editor world, not PIE, so an unpossessed pawn is an error. Returns sight_radius, lose_sight_radius and sight_sense_count; 0 means no sight config, nothing changed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Object name or editor label of the pawn or AIController in the editor world; the first match is used. |
| `sight_radius` | number | yes | New SightRadius in cm, greater than 0. |
| `lose_sight_radius` | number | no | New LoseSightRadius in cm, the distance at which an already seen target is lost, 0 or more; default sight_radius times 1.5. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name, sight_radius, lose_sight_radius, sight_sense_count }`

## `set_native_team_attitude`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Installs (once per process) a custom FGenericTeamId::AttitudeSolver backed by an MCP-owned symmetric table, then records the pairwise attitude for team_a/team_b. Pairs not explicitly set fall back to the engine's own default (same team -> Friendly, else Hostile). This drives the engine's own AI Perception affiliation filtering (Sight/Hearing/Touch DetectionByAffiliation), which reads FGenericTeamId::GetAttitude directly.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `team_a` | number | yes | Required int in [0, 255]. |
| `team_b` | number | yes | Required int in [0, 255]. |
| `attitude` | string | yes | Required: "Friendly"\|"Neutral"\|"Hostile". |

**Returns:** `{ team_a, team_b, attitude, resolved_attitude, solver_installed }`
